en-us.exp_event_erav_producer_small_photo_ongo: $names$ is called under the fill lights to practice her 'camera presence'.
en-us.exp_event_erav_producer_small_photo_resu:
$names$ is made to cycle expressions for the lens: aggrieved, lost, on the verge of tears. Each new one earns a burst of shutter clicks.
"Don't dodge the lens. Dodge it and you're worthless."
The president circles $names$ with his phone held low, shooting up her skirt. "Reference material for the project. ...Yes. Reference."
$names$ holds an awkward pose until her legs go numb. Where the photos get sent, she doesn't dare ask.
en-us.exp_event_erav_producer_small_styling_on: The president arrives with a clothes rack - today is 'costume fitting'.
en-us.exp_event_erav_producer_small_styling_re: $names$ is changed through three outfits, each with the same rule: keep the innocent parts, open the rest.
The president undoes two buttons of $names$'s blouse himself, steps back to appraise, then undoes the third. "The branding is 'pure'. But a pure girl who understands things."
en-us.exp_event_erav_producer_small_schedule_o: The president walks in on a call, gesturing $names$ to keep quiet.
en-us.exp_event_erav_producer_small_schedule_r: On the phone, the president books her 'slots' with other production committees. He pats her head as he hangs up: "All good projects. Don't be nervous."
$names$ tidies his proposals and card case, and is corrected on their order. "Secretary basics. Transfer agencies someday and you'll use all of it."
en-us.exp_event_erav_producer_small_quickie_on: The president snaps his proposal shut: "Oh, right - one more impromptu segment."
en-us.exp_event_erav_producer_small_quickie_re: The president presses $names$ under the fill lights for an 'impromptu audition', and only remembers to add "this take doesn't get recorded" afterward. His phone, meanwhile, sits on its stand, steady as ever.
